question: A person lent ₹2,000 at 6% per annum simple interest and ₹3,000 at 5% per annum simple interest. Find his total interest after 3 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use I = P × R × T ÷ 100 separately

For ₹2000: I = 2000 × 6 × 3 ÷ 100 = 360

For ₹3000: I = 3000 × 5 × 3 ÷ 100 = 450

Total Interest = 360 + 450 = 810

**∴ Answer = ₹810**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P₁ = 2000, R₁ = 6%, T = 3 years

P₂ = 3000, R₂ = 5%, T = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = P × R × T ÷ 100

 
• ₹2000 @6% ₹3000 @5% Time = 3 years 

**Calculations:**

⇒ I₁ = 2000 × 6 × 3 ÷ 100 = 360

⇒ I₂ = 3000 × 5 × 3 ÷ 100 = 450

⇒ Total Interest = 360 + 450 = 810

**∴ The correct answer is ₹810.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

Combined Principal Trick

If time is same, find weighted average rate and apply on total principal

Amount Formula

Amount = Principal + Interest

Rate Conversion

Percentage rate means per 100 → always divide by 100 in SI formula
